courses.title: General Physics-Mechanics and Heat and General Physics Laboratory I (or equivalent)
General Electives
courses.choice_note: Students should use elective and minor hours to satisfy the 42 advanced hour requirement. Advanced hours are 3000- and 4000-level courses. A minor is not required with this major but can be added and will normally fill most electives. A minor generally requires six semesters of coursework, a minimum of 18 credits (six advanced) in an approved field. A minor in MATH, as a common example, requires 10 additional hours beyond MATH 1420 and MATH 1430 .
